contexts.text: Jehovah hath prospered my way () = that all things are now foreseen.
He was a prosperous man () = that all things are foreseen. AC 4975.
To be prospered = to be provided.
Whatever he did Jehovah prospered () = that the Divine Providence is from Him.
That to be prospered, in the supreme sense, = Providence, is because everything prosperous, which appears in the ultimates of nature, is effected, in its origin, from the Lord's Divine Providence.
With those who trust in the Lord, everything... whether it appears prosperous or not prosperous, is good...
Those who have thought about the worldly life, and its prosperity, and still have lived a good moral life...
For the sake of prosperity in the world...

In order that he may be prosperous in the world, and blessed after death. He becomes prosperous and blessed, if he procures for himself wisdom, and keeps his will under obedience to it; but unprosperous and unhappy if he puts his understanding under obedience to his will. Explained. TCR 588.
They thus consult the temporal prosperity (of their children), and also their eternal happiness.
They know more clearly than others whether they are being prospered or not.
The will of Jehovah shall be prospered by His hand () = that thus everything in the Heavens and on earth will be kept in Divine order.
